entries.title: If You Build It, Will They Come? On the Sperm Racing World Cup
entries.summary: Onto Sperm Racing’s elegantly vulgar premise, the company has grafted a lame higher purpose intended to justify and temper the joyful stupidity of the enterprise.

entries.title: The Catalogue of Lost Things
entries.summary: Some favorite passages from the many new releases that wound up on our desks this July and August.
